audit.summary: Logo or asset audit failed: 4 blocker(s). Campaign audit failed: 2 on-campaign LEGO Pokémon retail product assets found (40892 Kanto Region Badge Collection, 72156 Squirtle SMART Set); 3 off-topic assets present (FIFA World Cup Trophy, Star Wars minifigures collection, Marvel Super Heroes minifigures collection). Minimum 3 on-campaign products required; maximum 5 permitted. Off-topic assets must be replaced with Pokémon-branded SKUs from the 2026 collaboration lineup. The LEGO® logo file is the correct official brand wordmark, but the audit has identified one critical finding: a missing Pokémon wordmark logo file. This collaboration campaign ('LEGO® Pokémon™') requires separate official wordmark files for each participating brand per the collaboration rules. The LEGO logo alone is valid and correct, but Pokémon branding is absent from the logos/ directory.

findings.issue: Missing Pokémon official wordmark logo file. The collaboration campaign 'LEGO® Pokémon™' lists two participating brands (The LEGO Group and The Pokémon Company International), but only the LEGO wordmark is present in logos/. Per collaboration rules, separate official wordmark files for each party should be sourced when available.
findings.fix_hint: Add an official Pokémon wordmark SVG or PNG file (e.g. logos/brand-pokemon.svg) to the logos/ directory. Retry search queries provided in brave_retry_queries.logos.
